_comment: The Chiang Rai provincial lodging register — licensed hotels and everything else that lets rooms, as ที่ทำการปกครองจังหวัดเชียงราย wrote them down. Owned wholesale by importers/harvest_lodging_cr.py (the enrich.json arrangement); hand-kept truth goes in OTHER curated files. NAME, อำเภอ and ตำบล only — the register carries no coordinates, phones, addresses or room counts. kindTh is the province's own free text, passed through unjudged: some rows are not lodging. Chiang Mai publishes no equivalent list, only counts.
